phases.name: Collapse inner whitespace in LinkedIn card lines

steps.name: Regression test: whitespace-noisy body parses like the clean fixture (RED)
criteria: A message built from the committed fixture 1a09a2b19d112bb8 with inner double spaces and tabs in one card's title, company and location lines, line indentation, and every newline converted to CRLF yields rows deep-equal to extractJobs of the unaltered fixture
The altered card's title, company and location are single-spaced with no leading or trailing whitespace
Job ids and dedup keys of the altered message match those of the unaltered fixture
A card salary line containing inner double spaces still yields min 59000 and max 78000
Against the current parser the test fails because the title differs by inner whitespace, not because of an error or missing fixture
No file under .cache/ is read or copied; only the committed redacted fixture is used
The step ends at RED: the failing test is not committed on its own; the crafter logs RED and proceeds in the same dispatch to step 01-02, whose COMMIT covers both steps
steps.scenario_name: inner whitespace runs, tabs, indentation and CRLF in card lines parse identically to the clean message

steps.name: Fix: collapse inner whitespace runs in trimmed card-line text (GREEN)
criteria: Titles, companies and locations never contain a whitespace run after parsing
Job ids, advert links, dedup keys and search term extraction are unchanged for raw lines
The full suite (39 files, 383 tests) plus the new test is green and no existing test is edited
src/core stays pure: no classes, no mutation, no node: builtins
The single commit for steps 01-01 and 01-02 carries trailers for step 01-02
steps.scenario_name: inner whitespace runs, tabs, indentation and CRLF in card lines parse identically to the clean message
